title: Concatenation of bounded computation spans
statement: Let a one-work-tape Turing machine have configurations $c,d,e$, and let $s,t$ be natural numbers and $\mathrm{lo},\mathrm{hi}$ integers. Suppose that the computation from $c$ reaches $d$ after $s$ steps and its work-head position stays in $[\mathrm{lo},\mathrm{hi}]$ at every time through $s$; also suppose that the computation from $d$ reaches $e$ after $t$ steps and its work-head position stays in the same interval at every time through $t$. Then the computation from $c$ reaches $e$ after $s+t$ steps, with its work-head position in that interval at every time through $s+t$.
